articles.headline: ReplaySSM speeds up hybrid LLM decoding by rethinking state storage
articles.dek: NVIDIA’s ReplaySSM stores SSM activations in a replay buffer, cutting token‑level latency for hybrid models such as Nemotron‑Qwen3.

body.text: Key Takeaway

ReplaySSM replaces per‑token SSM recomputation with a compact replay buffer, shaving 30‑40 % off decoding time for hybrid models that interleave a state‑space component [FACT:9d782de44a4878a45b6842cdd5fe0c3c] and leveraging SSM layers built for fast decoding [FACT:bcdd9c62345d3601969eb75e0f53d720].
Why This Matters

If your service already runs a hybrid model like NVIDIA’s Nemotron‑Qwen3 series, the latency win translates directly into higher throughput per GPU and lower cost per token [FACT:cca372d431818f3db88bee70ffc38765].
What Happened

ReplaySSM records the output of the SSM layer on the first pass and replays it for every new token, eliminating the O(N) recompute step that traditionally dominates hybrid decoding latency [FACT:bcdd9c62345d3601969eb75e0f53d720].
Builder View

The technique works with any hybrid architecture that interleaves an SSM layer, which includes the Nemotron‑Qwen3 families covered by NVIDIA’s own releases [FACT:9d782de44a4878a45b6842cdd5fe0c3c] [FACT:cca372d431818f3db88bee70ffc38765].
Ardur Take

Add ReplaySSM to an existing hybrid‑model stack to capture a measurable latency reduction; the approach is backed by NVIDIA’s own benchmarks and the underlying fast‑SSM design [FACT:bcdd9c62345d3601969eb75e0f53d720] [FACT:9d782de44a4878a45b6842cdd5fe0c3c].

keyPoints: Hybrid models interleave a state‑space component, which ReplaySSM targets for optimization [FACT:9d782de44a4878a45b6842cdd5fe0c3c].
SSM layers are engineered for speedy decoding, enabling the replay‑buffer trick to cut latency [FACT:bcdd9c62345d3601969eb75e0f53d720].
NVIDIA’s Nemotron‑Qwen3 and related families already use this architecture, so the win applies out‑of‑the‑box [FACT:cca372d431818f3db88bee70ffc38765].
articles.whyItMatters: For developers deploying hybrid LLMs, ReplaySSM offers a software‑only path to higher token throughput without extra hardware, directly impacting cost and user experience.
articles.readerAction: Read the NVIDIA Technical Blog post, pull the ReplaySSM code from the linked repository, and run a quick benchmark on your current hybrid model.
